blocks.text: Documents the two-part history and the propose→confirm/deny flow shape. Explains why list_dir/read_file must NOT go through propose/confirm: they're already always-free reads and routing a read through the confirmation gate would add latency with no safety benefit.
blocks.title: Module header and imports

blocks.text: _require_workspace calls chat_workspace.get_workspace and converts FileNotFoundError to 404. local_status uses it to gate the registry lookup; the endpoint itself is a cheap poll target for the frontend's connection-state indicator.
blocks.title: Workspace guard and status check

blocks.text: Two async routes: local_list_dir and local_read_file each call the workspace tool function directly (no propose/confirm) and map ToolCallError to 409. The comment explains the 409 semantics: distinct from 500 (server broken) and 404 (unknown workspace).
blocks.title: Read tool routes

blocks.text: ProposeActionRequest carries tool name and params dict. local_propose_action validates both via propose_action() (which rejects read tools and bad tool names with ValueError→400) and returns a ProposeActionResponse with the action_id and TTL. The daemon is never contacted at this stage.
blocks.title: Propose route

blocks.text: local_confirm_action awaits confirm_action(), which contacts the daemon. PendingActionError (unknown/expired/wrong-workspace action_id) becomes 404; ToolCallError or MCPClientError becomes 409. local_deny_action discards the pending action synchronously; the daemon is never contacted.
blocks.title: Confirm and deny routes

concepts: read tools bypass the proposal store
gotchas: Read tools (list_dir, read_file) must NOT go through propose/confirm — propose_action() rejects them with ValueError
409 means the workspace and request are well-formed but the daemon is unavailable or rejected the path/tool — distinct from 400 (bad request) and 500 (server error)
MCPClientError is also caught in local_confirm_action to handle the edge case of an MCP-sourced action_id arriving at the wrong route
how_it_works: Every route calls _require_workspace(ws_id, owner_id) first to 404 unknown or inaccessible workspaces before touching daemon state
local_status checks local_workspace.is_live(ws_id) — a registry lookup, not a daemon call — so the frontend can poll cheaply
local_list_dir and local_read_file await async workspace tool functions; ToolCallError maps to 409
local_propose_action calls propose_action() (validates tool name and params, writes pending action to store); 400 on ValueError from bad tool/params
local_confirm_action awaits confirm_action(), which contacts the daemon; 404 on unknown/expired action_id, 409 on daemon failure
local_deny_action calls deny_action() synchronously; 404 on unknown action_id, daemon never contacted
outputs: daemon tool results, proposal records, {action_id, status} on deny
purpose: Provides the HTTP surface that lets the browser interact with a daemon connected to a local workspace. Read operations (list_dir, read_file) run directly against the daemon on each call. Mutating operations (write_file, delete, execute_command) go through a propose→confirm/deny flow that stores a pending action server-side before anything reaches the daemon.
side_effects: daemon WebSocket round-trips on list_dir, read_file, and confirm
pending action written to in-process store on propose
pending action deleted from store on confirm and deny
summary: FastAPI router for daemon-backed workspace file operations: status check, list_dir, read_file, and propose/confirm/deny for mutating actions.

raises: HTTPException(404) if workspace unknown or inaccessible

Lists the contents of a directory inside the daemon's allowed root; 409 when no daemon is connected or the path is refused.

symbols.summary: Reads a file from inside the daemon's allowed root; 409 when no daemon is connected or the path is refused.

symbols.summary: Validates a mutating action request and stores it as a pending action; never contacts the daemon.
Runs a previously proposed action by forwarding it to the daemon; 404 on unknown/expired action_id, 409 on daemon failure.
Discards a pending action from the store without contacting the daemon; 404 if the action_id is unknown or expired.
